ModMetaData.name: RimFront
ModMetaData.author: RimFront contributors
ModMetaData.description: Experimental native first-person renderer for RimWorld. Control a drafted colonist inside the game's engine, with analog movement, native path fallback, modeled pawns and apparel, bounded limb animation, weapons and real-job reload animations, expanded scenery, observed projectile/impact effects, game-driven lighting, snow and weather. No browser, Modern Warfare 2 installation, or external engine is required. Combat Extended is optional; native attacks, ballistics, damage, reload timing and movement costs remain authoritative. Separate builds target RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Generic model families cover unfamiliar definitions; bespoke coverage and universal mod compatibility are not claimed. See README for validation and limitations.
